name: Nullframe CivPass Anthropomorphic Layered Set
description: A carefully constructed outfit of prosthetic-skin turtleneck, high-waisted wide-leg trousers, and a loose linen blazer — all chosen to obscure joint geometry and fill volumetrically around non-human proportions. The turtleneck is lined with a matte-finish synthskin layer that reduces the visual contrast of chassis seams at the neck. Shoes are platform-soled to bring height into human range. Every piece is ordinary; the effort to be ordinary is extraordinary.
functionality: Volume-filling cut obscures non-human joint geometry; synthskin lining reduces chassis seam visibility at neck and wrists.
what_it_says: There is nothing unusual about me. Please do not look closely.
worn_by: synthetics attempting to pass as human
manufacturer: Nullframe Design (various pieces), assembled by wearer
story_hooks: The chassis tape at the wrists is beginning to peel — one wrong gesture in a public space and the illusion breaks.
A Tier 3 office worker has been sitting next to this synthetic for six months and never noticed; today something feels off.
related_entities: Novafold Pharmaceuticals GraftSkin TS-7 Bioprinted Dermal Replacement Sheet

physical_description.visual_profile: A deliberately unremarkable silhouette designed to pass as human in low-resolution surveillance and casual observation. The layering creates soft, continuous lines that obscure the geometric precision of augmented joints. The overall impression is of someone trying very hard not to be noticed—which ironically makes them memorable to trained eyes.
physical_description.fit: Intentionally oversized and volumetric. The turtleneck sits high and snug to mask neck servos; the wide-leg trousers drape loosely to hide hip and knee articulation points; the linen blazer is cut generously through the shoulders to soften augmented musculature. Platform shoes add 3-4 inches of height to reach human baseline. Nothing clings.
physical_description.primary_material: Matte-finish synthetic skin (turtleneck lining), standard ballistic-weave cotton-blend (trousers), unbleached linen (blazer). Rubber and recycled composite platform soles. All materials chosen for availability and anonymity—nothing haute couture, nothing bespoke.
physical_description.texture: Smooth, muted finish on the synthskin; slightly nubbed texture on the trousers from the weave; loose, natural wrinkle pattern on the linen. The platform soles show mild wear. Everything is deliberately tactile and ordinary—no chrome, no gloss.
physical_description.color_scheme: Neutral palette: warm gray synthskin, charcoal trousers, cream linen blazer. Platform soles in matte black. No patterns, no logos visible, no accent colors. The intent is chromatic invisibility.
physical_description.closures: Turtleneck: seamless (no visible closure). Trousers: standard magnetic snap at waist, friction-fit zipper. Blazer: four magnetic snap buttons down the front, easily concealed beneath layers. Shoes: friction-fit slip-on with internal locking mechanism (invisible).
distinctive_features: Synthskin lining at neckline specifically designed to minimize chassis-seam visibility
Extra fabric volume at hip and knee joints
Shoulder panel reinforcement to distribute weight evenly across augmented frame
Purposefully generic brand tags (removed or obscured)
Platform shoes with internal gyroscopic stabilization (hidden)
No pockets on blazer—integrated storage accessed through chassis ports instead
physical_description.tier_indicator: Tier 3 functional, with deliberate downward presentation. The pieces are affordable, replaceable, and sourced from mainstream retailers. The effort to appear Tier 3 or Tier 4 signals someone trying to hide Tier 1-2 augmentation.
physical_description.cultural_context: This outfit is worn by those passing—unlicensed augments, corporate defectors, or synthetic entities navigating human-centric spaces. It signals paranoia, institutional distrust, and meticulous self-erasure. The wearer is saying: 'I do not want to be remarkable. Please do not look closely.'
physical_description.condition_typical: Pristine to broken-in. Pieces are rotated regularly to avoid wear patterns that might suggest non-human movement. The synthskin shows minor surface micro-abrasions from repeated wear. The linen blazer has soft wrinkles from storage, never pressed. Everything appears lived-in but not distressed.
